items.title: Tofu-Controller lightning talk @ Containerday 2026
items.summary: Slides for a 15-minute lightning talk at ContainerDay on running existing Terraform inside Kubernetes GitOps with tofu-controller, instead of rewriting it.The talk covers the Terraform custom resource, writing outputs to Secrets, ordering stacks and apps with dependsOn, approving plans through Git, drift detection, and the trade-offs.
